instruction.name: vrepli.h
instruction.description: Replicate a signed immediate into every h element.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vrepli.h $vr0, 1; vrepli.h $vr1, 1; vrepli.h $vr2, 1; vrepli.h $vr3, 1; vrepli.h $vr4, 1; vrepli.h $vr5, 1; vrepli.h $vr6, 1; vrepli.h $vr7, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr1, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4' --asm 'vrepli.h $vr0, 1; vrepli.h $vr1, 1; vrepli.h $vr2, 1; vrepli.h $vr3, 1; vrepli.h $vr4, 1; vrepli.h $vr5, 1; vrepli.h $vr6, 1; vrepli.h $vr7, 1'

notes: No source operand data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
